preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= 10**6 for x in stdin.split()) and len(stdin.split()) == 2
preconditions.description: The input consists of exactly two integers L and R, where 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ 10^6.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' or (stdout.strip() == 'YES' and all(line.strip() in ['YES', 'NO'] or (line.strip().isdigit() and 2 <= int(line.strip().split()[0]) <= 32) or (len(line.strip().split()) == 3 and all(line.strip().split()[i].isdigit() for i in range(3)) and 1 <= int(line.strip().split()[0]) < int(line.strip().split()[1]) <= int(line.strip().split()[0]) + 1) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:]))
postconditions.description: If no valid (L, R)-continuous city exists with n ≤ 32, output is 'NO'. Otherwise, output starts with 'YES', followed by n (2 ≤ n ≤ 32) and m (number of roads), then m lines of roads (a_i, b_i, c_i) where 1 ≤ a_i < b_i ≤ n and 1 ≤ c_i ≤ 10^6, with no duplicate roads.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'YES' and (lambda: any(all(1 <= int(x) <= 32 for x in line.split() if x.isdigit()) and (lambda lines: all(len(line.split()) == 3 and 1 <= int(line.split()[0]) < int(line.split()[1]) <= int(line.split()[0]) + 1 for line in lines))(stdout.splitlines()[2:])))(stdin) and (lambda: (lambda L, R: any((lambda n: any((lambda m, roads: all((lambda paths: all(L <= sum(c_i for (a_i, b_i, c_i) in path) <= R for path in paths) and len({sum(c_i for (a_i, b_i, c_i) in path) for path in paths}) == R - L + 1)(paths))(m, roads))(m, [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in lines]) for m in range(1, n*(n-1)//2 + 1) for lines in combinations([(i, j, 1) for i in range(1, n) for j in range(i+1, n+1)], m)))(n) for n in range(2, 33)))(int(stdin.split()[0]), int(stdin.split()[1]))))
postconditions.description: If output is 'YES', the city described must be (L, R)-continuous: all paths from block 1 to block n have lengths between L and R inclusive, and for every d in [L, R], there exists exactly one path with length d.
